execution_surface: Workspace shell; Computer Use refused access to co.zeit.hyper for safety reasons
isolation: Separate source copy; no original prepared data or outputs copied in. Fresh Conda environment, clean shell, user-site packages disabled. Only experimental DATA and candidate companion ZIP supplied.

inputs.purpose: Public experimental data for partial Figure 1 and S3 reproduction; model caches are absent
caveats: Input integrity does not imply complete manuscript reproduction: model fits, fall trials, supplementary model caches, Sanchez data and optimization solutions are absent.

Public CSVs are six-decimal exports; reconstruction preserves CSV values and is not byte-exact recovery of full-precision author MAT files. Source rounding is at most 0.5e-6 in measured units for the audited dataset.
Per-subject processed MAT files, raw C3D recordings and participant metadata are not copied or required for this CSV import.
Missing tied2 energy and SLA short_idx values are not synthesized; the submitted analysis uses available tied/split measurements and fractional-stride windows.
The public DSA CSV includes absent final samples in some records; their positions are retained and listed in participant_mapping, never filled or interpolated.

full_inputs.purpose: Cached numerical reproduction of the submitted publication; not a raw simulation rerun
caveats: Original and regenerated realizations are retained separately.
Raw COSMED and OpenSim optimization inputs are not supplied by this import.
Reference tables may describe earlier analyses; use per-figure exported tables for plotted data.
No regenerated S3 rollout subset is synthesized or inferred from fitted parameters.

limits: macOS arm64 tested; Linux/Windows and remote CI not run here
Local user-supplied experimental archive used; anonymous Zenodo download cannot be verified while files are restricted
Companion archive is a local release candidate, not yet deposited
Saved-data reproduction; no full stochastic sweeps, raw C3D/COSMED processing, OpenSim optimization or fresh MATLAB S1 recomputation in this test
Known partial panels and manuscript discrepancies remain documented
